title: 10、斩草除根，余波未平
slug: 摇曳歌姬全本免费-摇曳歌姬最新章节列表
content_zh:
南香绫在一旁看着，眉头微皱。
“好了，暂时就到这里，休息一下吧。”秦老师一击掌，让两人停下，随后她走到了南香绫的身旁坐下。
“怎么样？”南香绫递上水问道。
接过水，秦老师露出有些为难的神情说道：“我觉得有点麻烦。其实单论身体素质的话，两个都还不错。高个子的那个以前练过武，身体素质很好，动作干脆利落。不过缺点也很明显，动作太干脆，缺少美感。她不够柔和，太硬了。”
“那小的呢？”
南香绫好奇问道。
泉镜花与夏风瑶虽然坐在远处休息，但也是竖起了耳朵听着。
秦老师说道：“从欣赏的角度来看，还是很可爱的。不过她太软了，感觉缺少力度。没办法学比较激烈的舞蹈。而且以我多年的经验来看，她的抗拒心理很重。太羞涩了，放不开。这种人长的再可爱，也是没办法上舞台的。”
听到秦老师的话，泉镜花闭上了嘴巴，连一丝反驳的想法都没有。
说自己软她不得不承认，这个身体十分软，简直就给人一种棉花糖甜甜软软一样的感觉。
至于放不开，她怎么可能放的开！
曾经也是堂堂男儿。
只不过遭遇了另类的去势，她可是以太史公作为自己的偶像，就算是成为软萌妹子了，也要做出一番事业来。
现在居然要去搔首弄姿，还要去吸引粉丝？只要一想到今后会有一群人在台下观看自己，她就不由自主的既紧张又担忧。甚至还有一点小小的恶心感。
她的脸色有些难看，夏风瑶还以为她是因为学的不成功所以失落，在一旁安慰道：“没关系的啦，只是第一次，而且你本来就体弱嘛，不适合运动呢！”
泉镜花本来想回复她，不过感觉到自己的身体已经有些吃不消了，只好赶紧调整呼吸。
“我真的，讨厌运动……”
前世的泉镜花就不爱运动，这一世换成这样的身体就更缺少运动了，此时只是稍微运动了一番她就有些累。
而夏风瑶但是显得十分轻松。
“是吗？我倒是很喜欢运动。”

“真不愧是功夫少女。”泉镜花慢慢的平复了呼吸节奏，安定了下来。
“我其实很想跟镜花你一起运动的。”
“不行，我跟不上你的节奏。”泉镜花摇了摇头说道。
“我可以等你的嘛，就算这样感觉也很好啊。”夏风瑶歪过头来，看到泉镜花靠在椅子上，身体因为深呼吸而微微起伏。
尤其是胸口的位置，随着呼吸的节奏缓缓运动着，仿佛能够感受到一种生命的脉动。那种微弱的摇曳感，仿佛是用手去触摸幼小猫咪的肚子感受到的感觉一样。
“真好呢，这样看明显多了，而且还会摇呀摇！”夏风瑶托腮欣赏着眼前的风景。
而泉镜花自己却是苦恼无比。
其实，要单纯说大小，镜花跟巨什么的根本扯不上关系。即使是相对来看，也在还可以接受的范围内。
但是，架不住她软。
就好像比较软的馒头会比较大一样，她稍微运动一下，就会自然而然的引人注意，尤其是在这样娇小的身体的反衬下。
所以泉镜花才越发的讨厌运动，当然，因为害羞而不愿意去买合适的掩护用具也是镜花自己的问题。
想到自己的身体，泉镜花心中就越发的恐惧。
明明上面发育了，但是下面却依旧仿佛幼女一般没有丝毫变化。也不知道是不是以后就会那样了。
从一个堂堂男儿变成了软萌妹子。
泉镜花的人生经历，可以用这样的四个成语来形容。
杀鸡取卵，斩草除根，大势已去，余波未平。
虽然泉镜花绝不承认自己前世的势绝不算大，但是这一世的波，似乎是很的平不了。
虽然不是海水那样的波涛汹涌，却总是像平静的湖面，只要稍稍有风，就能摇曳出一片涟漪。
这，似乎又是一种别样的味道。
而在远处，南香绫与秦老师却是在交流着。

“有什么办法吗？”
“我觉得对于夏同学，最重要的不是动作是否标准，而是让她变得柔和起来。而相反的，泉同学的话，要更加放开一点。太内向了不好。而且这对于她的成长也是不利的。并且，一个内向羞涩的人，没办法当偶像的吧。”
“的确，不过我倒是不那么觉得。”想到曾经给自己送上蓝白条纹的泉镜花，南香绫嘴角浮现出笑容。“我觉得她只是还没到紧要的关头而已。”

content_en:
Nan Xiangling looked on, frowning slightly.
"Okay, let's stop here for now, let's take a rest." Teacher Qin high-fived the two of them to stop, and then she walked to Nan Xiangling's side and sat down.
"How is it?" Nan Xiangling asked as she handed over some water.
After receiving the water, Teacher Qin looked a little embarrassed and said: "I think it's a bit troublesome. In fact, in terms of physical fitness, both of them are pretty good. The taller one has practiced martial arts before, and her physical fitness is very good, and her movements are crisp and neat. However, the shortcomings are also obvious. Her movements are too crisp and lack beauty. She is not soft enough and too hard."
"What about the little one?"
Nan Xiangling asked curiously.
Although Quan Jinghua and Xia Fengyao were sitting far away and resting, they also listened with their ears pricked up.
Teacher Qin said: "From an appreciation point of view, she is still very cute. But she is too soft and lacks strength. She cannot learn more intense dances. And based on my years of experience, she has a lot of resistance. She is too shy and can't let go. No matter how cute this kind of person is, there is no way she can go on stage."
After hearing Teacher Qin's words, Quan Jinghua closed her mouth without even a thought to refute.
When she said she was soft, she had to admit that this body was very soft, almost giving people the sweet and soft feeling of a marshmallow.
As for not letting go, how could she let go!
He was once a handsome man.
It's just that she suffered a different kind of castration. She regards Tai Shigong as her idol. Even if she becomes a cute girl, she still has to make a career.
Now you actually want to show off and attract fans? Whenever she thought about a group of people watching her in the audience in the future, she couldn't help but feel nervous and worried. There was even a little nausea.
Her face looked a little ugly. Xia Fengyao thought she was disappointed because she failed in her studies, and comforted her: "It's okay, it's just your first time, and you are already weak and not suitable for exercise!"
Quan Jinghua originally wanted to reply to her, but felt that her body was already a little overwhelmed, so she had to quickly adjust her breathing.
"I really hate exercise..."
In her previous life, Izumi Kyoka didn't like to exercise. In this life, she lacked exercise even more with a body like this. Now she was a little tired after just a little exercise.
But Xia Fengyao seemed very relaxed.
"Really? I really like sports."
"As expected of a kung fu girl." Quan Jinghua slowly calmed down her breathing rhythm and settled down.
"I actually want to exercise with you Kyoka."
"No, I can't keep up with your pace." Quan Jinghua shook her head and said.
"I can wait for you. Even if it feels like this, it still feels good." Xia Fengyao tilted her head and saw Quan Jinghua leaning on the chair, her body rising and falling slightly due to deep breathing.
Especially the chest, which moves slowly with the rhythm of breathing, seems to be able to feel the pulse of life. The faint swaying feeling is like touching the belly of a young kitten with your hand.
"It's great. It looks much better this way, and it can also shake!" Xia Fengyao held her chin up and admired the scenery in front of her.
But Quan Jinghua herself was extremely distressed.
In fact, if we simply talk about size, Jinghua has nothing to do with giantness or anything like that. Even from a relative perspective, it is within an acceptable range.
However, she couldn't stand it.
Just like a softer bun will be larger, if she moves a little, she will naturally attract attention, especially against such a petite body.
That's why Izumi Kyoka hates sports more and more. Of course, being shy and unwilling to buy suitable protective equipment is also Kyoka's own problem.
Thinking of her own body, Quan Jinghua became more and more frightened.
The upper part has obviously grown, but the lower part is still as unchanged as a young girl. I don’t know if it will happen in the futureIt will be like that.
From a dignified man to a cute girl.
Quan Jinghua's life experience can be described by these four idioms.
Killing the chicken to get the egg, cutting the grass and eradicating the root, the situation is over, but the aftermath is not over.
Although Izumi Kyoka would never admit that her power in the previous life was not great, the waves in this life seemed to be unstoppable.
Although it is not as rough as the sea, it is always like a calm lake. As long as there is a little wind, it can sway a ripple.
This seems to be a different flavor.
But in the distance, Nan Xiangling and Teacher Qin were communicating.
"Is there any way?"
"I think the most important thing for Xia-san is not whether her movements are standard, but to make her softer. On the contrary, for Quan-san, she should be more relaxed. Being too introverted is not good. And it is also detrimental to her growth. Besides, an introverted and shy person cannot be an idol."
"Indeed, but I don't think so." Thinking of the blue and white striped spring mirror flower that she once gave herself, a smile appeared on Nan Xiangling's lips. "I think she just hasn't reached the critical moment yet."
